title: Admin Always allow — the existing menu, two more scopes

steps.headline: The existing confirmation gains Full Auto and session-only choices.
steps.changed: This reuses the same confirmation as pushing: heading, command, warning, scope choices, limits, and the existing green/red actions. Only this exact command stays selected by default.
steps.notice: Always allow in Full Auto covers passwordless admin commands across projects and future sessions. Allow all for this session covers them in any mode, until the session closes. The limits line follows your choice.
steps.risk: This is still a UI preview; the saved/session allowances are not connected. Password entry will remain separate.

steps.headline: The same compact menu fits on a phone.
steps.changed: The custom Back / Confirm and run design is gone. The existing Nevermind, allow once / Always allow actions remain.
steps.notice: All three scope choices stay visible; the explanation beneath changes with the selection.
steps.risk: The two action labels wrap on a narrow screen, as the existing confirmation does.
